                                                                                
 Usage: agentarts runtime stop-session [OPTIONS]                                
                                                                                
 Stop runtime session (cloud only).                                             
                                                                                
 Examples:                                                                      
 agentarts runtime stop-session --agent myagent --session <session-id>          
 agentarts runtime stop-session -a myagent -s <session-id> -bt <bearer-token>   
 agentarts runtime stop-session -a myagent -s <session-id> -e myendpoint        
 agentarts runtime stop-session -a myagent -s <session-id>                      
 --skip-ssl-verification                                                        
                                                                                
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --agent                  -a       <str>  Agent name                          │
│ --session                -s       <str>  Session ID                          │
│ --bearer-token           -bt      <str>  Bearer token for authentication     │
│ --region                 -r       <str>  Region name                         │
│ --endpoint               -e       <str>  Endpoint name                       │
│ --skip-ssl-verification  -k              Skip SSL certificate verification   │
│ --user-id                -u       <str>  User ID for OAuth2 outbound         │
│                                          credentials                         │
│ --help                                   Show this message and exit.         │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
